# Mic Gnome

> A browser patch bay for the Teenage Engineering EP-2350 fx-mic: build effect chains, hear an impression of them, and make the config.json the mic reads. Not affiliated with Teenage Engineering.

- The mic's setup is config.json on its USB disk, and a broken file stops the mic booting. Mic Gnome checks it for errors first.
- "Write" goes to a virtual fx-mic in the browser. For the real one, download the files and copy them onto its disk.
- The sound in the browser is an impression of the effect chain, not the mic.
- The pack library says which packs have been tested on hardware and which have not.

## Pages

- [Mic Gnome](https://micgnome.stephen8n.com/): effect chains, samples, the pack library and a helper
- [Printed manual](https://micgnome.stephen8n.com/zine): the effects and settings, for A4
- [Booklet](https://micgnome.stephen8n.com/zine-booklet): the same as a small booklet

## Source

- [micgnome](https://github.com/stephencummins/micgnome)
